program_open.note: UNKNOWN: no page on % or program header found.

program_close.value: M30 = end and rewind (optional L<n> repeats n times; L0 loops forever); M02 = end, later lines not run.

comment.value: Parentheses (text), not nested. Semicolon comments not mentioned. MSG command exists for on-screen messages.

line_numbers.value: Optional N, readability only, no effect on execution; no maximum stated.

safe_start.value: Supported (have pages): G90, G94, G17, G21, G40, G80. G43 and G49 are NOT in the supported G-code list. Any unsupported command or bad syntax makes MASSO skip the WHOLE line and continue.
safe_start.where: Supported G-codes list; S3 Invalid Gcode
safe_start.note: Never put a needed motion on a line with an unsupported code (e.g. G43 H1 Z5 would be skipped entirely - inferred from S3).

tool_change.value: T<n> M06 - T must precede M06 on the line (M06 T5 behaves differently and may load the wrong tool). Stop spindle with M05 before M06. G3 tools T1-T100 for spindle (G2: 0-31).

tool_change_behaviour.value: Built-in tool changer logics, no user macro needed. Manual tool changer: spindle off, Z to home then XY to change position, waits for operator + Cycle Start, optional tool setter measures the tool (Auto Tool Zero) and applies the length, else uses the F4 tool table Z offset; XY return. Same tool already loaded -> change skipped.

tool_length_comp.value: Applied by the control at the tool change (tool table or tool setter); no G43/H word in the supported list.
tool_length_comp.note: Whether G43 is silently ignored or skips the line: S3 says unsupported commands skip the line.

spindle.value: S speed, M03 CW, M04 CCW, M05 off (pages exist in supported list).
spindle.note: Page bodies for M03-M05 not read.

arc_format.value: G02/G03 X Y Z with I J K always incremental from start. R allowed only for arcs up to 90 deg; use I/J/K above 90 deg.

feed.value: F units/min (G94), mm with G21; does not exceed axis max feed.

retract_home.value: G53 G00 Z0 rapids Z to top of travel (machine coords, non-modal; MASSO's own example before tool change). G28 = rapid to machine home (Z first), G91 G28 Z0 = straight home; machine must be homed. G30 = parking position.
retract_home.note: G28 from S9; G30 from S25.

coolant.value: M07 mist, M08 flood, M09 all off. No through-spindle code.

dwell.value: G04 P<milliseconds> (P required; G04 P2000 = 2 s).

drill_G81.value: G81 X Y Z R K F (R required; K repeats at same spot).

dwell_drill_G82.value: G82 X Y Z R K P F ; P in milliseconds.

peck_G83.value: G83 X Y Z R Q K F ; Q incremental peck >0.

chipbreak_G73.value: G73 X Y Z R Q K F ; fixed 1.0 mm retract between pecks.

rigid_tap_G84.note: UNKNOWN: G84 is not in MASSO's supported G-code list (and therefore a line with it would be skipped per S3).

bore_G85.note: UNKNOWN: G85 is not in MASSO's supported G-code list.

return_level.value: G98 initial Z; G99 R plane.

cycle_cancel.value: G80 cancels cycle, then G00 mode. Cancel with G80 before starting a different cycle.

native_language.value: Standard-style G-code only (supported subset listed); no mode switch.

notes: Subset control: no G43/G49, no G84/G85/G86-89 listed. Unsupported code -> whole line skipped silently. Dwell in ms. Arc R limited to <=90 deg. T before M06 is mandatory.
